about: Cohen, Snyder & Eisenberg, P.A. is a workers' compensation firm with offices in Baltimore, Essex and Glen Burnie.

The firm states that the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish. It does not state a fee model on its public pages, so none is recorded here.

G1.evidence: Maryland does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Attorney Grievance Commission of Maryland, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 2614 published discipline decisions of the Attorney Grievance Commission of Maryland, 1976 to 2026. 2 of them share a surname with a disciplined attorney and were read against the text of those decisions, which name somebody else. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 3 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. Maryland publishes no business register we can query. SDAT's entity search is a form rather than a dataset, its bulk data is sold rather than published, and the state's open data portal carries a count of businesses instead of the register. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 7 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 189 public client reviews across 3 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2000-08-10, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
